selection_method: Stable curated coverage: three US listings and two Malaysian listings per group, selected for monitoring diversity; not a performance ranking or recommendation.
collection_policy: Collect the latest eligible market quote and decision-time evidence for each listed instrument on every report run. Preserve venue, currency, source, quote timestamp, and timezone. Never fabricate a missing quote; mark it unavailable with the source limitation in the dated report.
taxonomy_notes: This cross-market shortlist is a monitoring taxonomy, not the canonical GICS or Bursa Malaysia classification.
The benchmarks group contains ETFs and is not a sector.

Semiconductors is an industry overlay within Information Technology. This collection keeps distinct constituents in each group to avoid duplicate ticker rows; review classification if an issuer's primary business changes.
Healthcare and Consumer Staples are explicit groups. Malaysian primary classifications differ; retain the exchange classification and sub-industry tag in each generated report.

Version 2 reduces daily collection to 50 names (30 US / 20 MY). Version 1 and historical snapshots remain preserved. Current cap, liquidity and expected-return rankings were not independently established.
